R0_limitation: R=0 subtraction controls the fixed one-time differential, not absence of live-range/register/scheduling interactions
barrier_contract: Tied-copy mapping/count/symmetry and SASS loop MOV/IMAD.MOV remain observed; indirect effects UNISOLATED_NOT_ASSUMED_ZERO
fingerprint_contract: Unchanged frozen family: exact full sequence or exact full multiset; not operand/dataflow/whole-binary equivalence

reason_semantics.BARRIER_CONTRACT_FAILURE: Empty asm, tied-copy dataflow, symmetry or explicit loop MOV gate fails
reason_semantics.CANONICAL_LAYOUT_DRIFT: Observed canonical layout differs from frozen expectation
reason_semantics.COMPILE_FAILURE_DETERMINISTIC: Deterministic compiler failure, never infrastructure PENDING
reason_semantics.CORRECTNESS_FAILURE: Non-timed reduction correctness or launch smoke failed
reason_semantics.INFRASTRUCTURE_FAILURE: Temporary infrastructure failure or fragmentation; at most one entire-case fresh-container repair
reason_semantics.REDUCTION_TEMPLATE_MISMATCH: Canonical terminal exchange missing from runtime loop
reason_semantics.REPEATED_ACCUMULATOR_CONFOUND: FP32 accumulator, global/atomic or other forbidden loop effect
reason_semantics.REPEATED_EXTRA_MEMORY_EFFECT: Complete runtime loop memory multiset differs from canonical reduction
reason_semantics.REPEATED_REDUCTION_MISMATCH: Repeated complete loop fingerprint multiset differs
reason_semantics.REPEATED_TILE_RELOAD: TMA or initial tile LocalLoad not isolated before runtime loop
reason_semantics.RESIDENCY_MISMATCH: Candidate blocks/SM or active warps/SM differ for any frozen harness
reason_semantics.R_SPECIALIZED: Runtime R unspecialized source/IR contract fails
reason_semantics.SINGLE_LOCALLOAD_MISMATCH: Complete ordered single LocalLoad sequence differs
reason_semantics.SINGLE_REDUCTION_MISMATCH: Frozen complete filtered fingerprint multiset differs
reason_semantics.STRUCTURAL_CONTRACT_FAILURE: Actual IR/PTX/SASS fails a frozen structural contract
reason_semantics.UNRESOLVED_TOOL_FAILURE: Artifact export or occupancy tool failure; no complete timing eligibility

residency_contract: Reuse frozen Stage A/B: matched candidate blocks/SM and active warps/SM for canonical, single and repeated
resource_fields: Driver static SMEM, dynamic launch SMEM and cuobjdump SHARED stay separate; driver local bytes and raw cuobjdump LOCAL/STACK stay separate (driver local=LOCAL+STACK); nonzero LOCAL or STACK excludes; exact-CUBIN occupancy only
